method: Dirac (what it forces to exist) + Einstein (what it fundamentally is)

deepened.dirac: Take the merge literally: each concept is a finite nutrient pool of informative gradient, and fitting it converts informative signal into noise. Then the following MUST exist. (1) A conserved-information ledger: if informative gradient is depletable, there is a scalar I_c(t) per concept (integral of informative-gradient mass consumed) that monotonically falls, and its time-derivative is the loss-decrease rate on that concept. Depletability forces I_c to be bounded below by zero, so every concept has a finite 'total extractable signal' budget B_c = I_c(0). (2) A crash point as a stationary feature of the gradient-noise-scale (GNS) trajectory, not a threshold: at the bloom peak dI_c/dt is maximal (inflection of loss), and the per-concept GNS = E|g|^2_grad-of-variance / |E g|^2 must DIVERGE as the mean informative gradient ->0 while residual variance persists. So the merge forces a pole (asymptote to infinity, or a sharp max if regularized) in per-concept GNS at exhaustion — a singular signature, derivable as the ratio of two terms one of which ->0. (3) A two-timescale separation: bloom rise time tau_rise (set by curvature/learning rate on the concept) MUST be shorter than crash onset, because overshoot requires the population to grow faster than the resource regenerates — i.e. the dynamics are an over-damped predator-prey/logistic-with-delay, which forces a delay parameter and hence the possibility of oscillation (re-blooms) if data is re-injected. (4) The drying-pool term forces a variance law: as a concept's easy examples are fit, the surviving hard-residual fraction f_hard ->small but their per-example gradient norm is large, so within-batch gradient variance for that concept scales like 1/f_hard — GNS rises BEFORE loss flattens. This forces an EARLY-WARNING ordering: GNS-crash precedes loss-plateau by a fixed lead time set by tau_rise. (5) Carrying-capacity object: because capacity 'returns to the pool like water', total optimizer capacity is conserved across concepts, forcing a competitive-exclusion law — concepts compete for batch share and the equilibrium mixture is the one where marginal informative-gradient-per-example is equalized across all active concepts (a 'gradient-marginal-equalization' fixed point), the ML analogue of the ideal-free-distribution in ecology.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this is a thermodynamics of information extraction: a minibatch optimizer is a forager dissipating a finite free-energy gradient, and learning is the relaxation of a per-concept chemical potential (informative-gradient-per-example) toward equilibrium. The deep invariant is that signal-to-noise is not a fixed property of data but a CONSUMED resource whose depletion is detectable as a divergence in the second-moment statistics before it is visible in the first moment (loss). Restated maximally: optimization is a population dynamics on a difficulty-resource manifold, and every learning curve is a logistic overshoot whose crash is the moment marginal information equals marginal noise. The GNS is the order parameter; its per-concept divergence is a phase transition (rich-gradient phase -> noise-dominated phase).
deepened.sharpened_mechanism: Maintain per-concept (per-cluster) running estimates of the gradient noise scale B_c(t) = tr(Sigma_c)/|mu_c|^2 using the standard small/large-batch or EMA-of-grad-moments estimator restricted to examples of concept c. Fit each B_c(t) trajectory to a logistic-overshoot template (rise time tau_rise, crash time tau_crash, peak height). Declare concept c 'mined out' when d log B_c/dt crosses a positive threshold (the crash onset) AND loss-slope on c is still nonzero — that gap is the early-warning lead. On detection, move batch share from c proportionally to its marginal informative-gradient |mu_c|^2/tr(Sigma_c), driving the mixture toward gradient-marginal-equalization across active concepts. Re-inject a probe batch of c periodically to detect re-bloom (delayed regeneration), which distinguishes truly-exhausted concepts from temporarily-saturated ones.
deepened.what_it_forces_that_parents_dont: Neither parent yields the EARLY-WARNING LEAD TIME: the algal-bloom parent gives overshoot-then-crash but has no notion of a second-moment statistic preceding a first-moment one; the GNS parent (T010) is defined as a single global scalar for batch-size selection and has no per-concept resolution or trajectory, so it cannot diverge. The merge forces (a) a per-concept GNS POLE at exhaustion and (b) a quantified lead time tau_rise by which the variance signal precedes the loss plateau — a saturation detector with a derivable head-start, which is exactly the object neither logistic ecology nor scalar GNS contains.
deepened.strongest_falsifiable_prediction: For any concept/cluster being learned, the per-concept gradient-noise-scale will reach its sharp maximum (crash) a measurable, roughly constant number of steps BEFORE that concept's loss curve flattens to within epsilon of its asymptote — i.e. GNS-crash is a leading indicator of per-concept saturation, with positive lead time, not coincident with or lagging the loss plateau.
deepened.minimal_experiment: Train a small classifier or 2-layer MLP/transformer (1-10M params) on a mixture of 4-8 clearly separable concept clusters (e.g. CIFAR superclasses, or synthetic Gaussian-mixture/algorithmic tasks). Log per-concept loss and per-concept GNS (two-batch estimator or EMA grad-moment ratio) every K steps. Metric: cross-correlation lag between the GNS-peak time and the loss-plateau time per concept. Expected signal: GNS peak leads loss plateau by a consistent positive lag across concepts (and lag ~ tau_rise of each concept). Null: GNS peak coincides with or trails loss plateau, or per-concept GNS shows no sharp peak. Cheap ablation: prune a concept at its GNS-crash vs at its loss-plateau and compare final accuracy/compute — the merge predicts pruning at GNS-crash loses negligible accuracy while saving the tail compute.

parents.name: Stranded ecosystem in a drying pool

deepened.original_mechanism: Reframe the data a batch 'consumes' as a nutrient pool with feedback. (1) BLOOM-CRASH (L141): treat each cluster/concept in the data as a finite nutrient; the optimizer 'blooms' (rapid loss decrease) on a concept while its effective per-example gradient signal is rich, but as the model fits that concept its remaining informative gradient is EXHAUSTED, so the bloom overshoots and the per-concept gradient-noise-scale spikes (signal gone, only noise left) — a crash signature. (2) DRYING-POOL crowding (L140): as a concept's informative examples shrink, the surviving 'hard residual' examples are crowded into a small high-variance pool that dominates the batch, raising the gradient noise scale locally. Mechanism = monitor a per-concept gradient-noise-scale and detect the bloom->crash transition (signal-to-noise collapse) to decide when a concept is 'mined out' and reweight the data mixture away from it, redistributing capacity like water returning to a drying pool.
deepened.original_what_it_produces: A data-mixture controller that uses per-concept gradient-noise-scale TRAJECTORIES (not the global scalar) to detect concept saturation, plus the prediction that informative-gradient exhaustion produces a characteristic overshoot-then-noise-spike curve per concept. Measurable object: a per-concept 'bloom-crash' SNR trajectory whose crash point predicts diminishing returns earlier than aggregate loss does — a stopping/reweighting signal for curriculum and data-pruning.
deepened.human_blind_spot_reason: Gradient noise scale is treated as one global number for setting batch size; nobody resolves it per-concept and reads it as a population trajectory. The bloom-overshoot-crash and drying-pool-crowding shapes are ecology, mentally filed far from optimizer telemetry, so the per-concept exhaustion signature is missed.

deepened.merged_construct: Natal-basin homing with directional growth record (salmon-moss mode connectivity)
deepened.dirac: Take the construct literally: barrier-crossing is a budgeted upstream migration, and the climb leaves a passive directional record. Then these MUST exist. (1) A motion-defined barrier functional distinct from the static ridge: if crossing costs 'lifetime reserves', there is an ACTION integral S = integral over the path of (loss above the connecting baseline) ds, and the minimal homing budget is min_path S subject to endpoint = target basin. This forces a quantity — barrier-under-motion — that is generically LARGER than the static saddle height (the min-max along the cheapest curve) because a budget-limited swimmer cannot take the measure-zero optimal saddle path; the gap between dynamic budget and static saddle is an entailed, measurable object. (2) A per-parameter sign/orientation accumulator: 'lay down a compass along the path' forces a vector field c_i = integral sign(or normalized) of the gradient-ascent step component on parameter i over the climb. Because the basins are related by a permutation/scaling symmetry of the network, this accumulated direction MUST be permutation-covariant: the climb that minimizes action is the one that moves along the symmetry orbit toward alignment, so c encodes the aligning permutation P. (3) Therefore the merge FORCES a theorem-shaped claim: the cheapest homing direction is the geodesic on the symmetry group toward the target's orbit representative, hence the accumulated compass c is a sufficient statistic for P — you can DECODE the matching permutation from the climb log without solving the assignment problem separately. (4) Budget monotonicity: minimal homing budget S* must be a monotone increasing function of the 'misalignment distance' d(P) (e.g. permutation distance / orbit geodesic length) between the two solutions — two facts collapse into one curve S*(d). (5) A spawning condition: the merge ('average succeeds only at the natal basin') forces a sharp threshold — interpolation/averaging loss as a function of how far along the homing path you stop must stay high until the path enters the target basin, then drop discontinuously; i.e. there is an arrival point, not a gradual descent. (6) Irreversibility/energetics: like a salmon spending reserves, the climb consumes an optimization budget that is not recovered by descending the far side, forcing an accounting where round-trip cost > 0 (a hysteresis between the two basins).
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this is least-action transport on a quotient manifold: the loss landscape modulo the network's symmetry group is the real arena, and two 'separate' solutions are the same point seen in two gauges. Mode connectivity is then a gauge-alignment problem, and the homing migration is a geodesic flow toward the symmetry orbit, with the salmon's energy budget = the action of that geodesic and the moss compass = the holonomy/parallel-transport record of which gauge transformation was traversed. The deep invariant: the cost to merge two models and the transformation that aligns them are the SAME object — an action integral whose integrand-direction IS the alignment. Crossing a barrier and discovering a symmetry are one act.
deepened.sharpened_mechanism: Initialize at model A. Perform budgeted ascent toward model B's basin along the steepest CONNECTABLE direction (project gradient ascent to reduce loss-to-B while climbing the A-B ridge), spending a fixed reserve R per phase and accepting transient high loss. During ascent accumulate per-parameter c_i = running sum of normalized step components (the compass). Decode candidate permutation P by sorting/Hungarian-matching on the structure of c restricted to permutation-symmetric neuron groups (c gives the alignment ordering directly). Detect 'arrival/spawning' as the step where linear-interpolation loss between current iterate and B drops below threshold (basin entry). Record S* = total reserve spent to arrive. Report S*(d) curve over pairs and compare decoded P to the brute-force optimal matching.
deepened.what_it_forces_that_parents_dont: Neither parent yields the equivalence 'crossing cost = alignment transformation.' The mode-connectivity parent (T002) treats the barrier as a static existence question (does a low-loss path exist after a separately-solved permutation?). The salmon parent gives budgeted upstream return but no symmetry; the moss parent gives a passive directional record but no landscape. Fused, they FORCE that the directional climb-log is a sufficient statistic for the aligning permutation — i.e. you recover the matching as a free by-product of crossing, and the dynamic budget S* is a tighter, motion-aware barrier than the static saddle. That dual object (decode-alignment-from-path + dynamic-barrier > static-barrier) belongs to no parent alone.
deepened.strongest_falsifiable_prediction: The per-parameter directional 'compass' accumulated while budget-crossing the ridge from net A toward net B decodes the alignment permutation P between A and B with accuracy strictly better than chance (and approaching the brute-force optimal matching), AND the minimal homing budget S* is a monotone increasing function of the A-B permutation/orbit distance.
deepened.minimal_experiment: Train 2-4 small MLPs/CNNs (50k-500k params) on the same task from different seeds (so they differ by a permutation + noise). For each pair: (1) compute the ground-truth aligning permutation via standard activation/weight matching (the reference). (2) Run budgeted ridge-crossing ascent from A toward B accumulating the per-neuron compass; decode a permutation from it. Metric A: agreement between decoded P and reference P (fraction of neurons matched). Metric B: correlation between S* (reserve to reach B's basin) and reference permutation distance across pairs; also compare S* to the static min-max saddle height on a naive linear path. Expected signal: decoded-vs-reference agreement well above chance; S* monotone in distance and S* > static-saddle on the naive path. Null: compass decodes at chance, or S* is flat/uncorrelated with misalignment. Cost: hours on one GPU; everything is small-net.
deepened.original_mechanism: Two transferred skeletons. (1) NATAL HOMING (L135): reframe barrier-crossing between two solution basins as an energetically-costly upstream return to a 'natal' basin — define a homing procedure that spends a controlled budget (like lifetime reserves) to push a model UP the loss ridge along the steepest connectable direction toward a target basin, accepting transient high loss as the cost of return, then arriving for a single 'spawning' event (a merge/average that only succeeds at the natal basin). The budget needed to reach the natal basin measures the true barrier height under motion, not the static ridge. (2) MOSS COMPASS (L134): along the crossing path, lay down a passive directional record — accumulate, per parameter, a sign/orientation statistic of the gradient direction climbed (the 'shaded-face' analog), so the arrived model carries an encoding of WHICH way it climbed. This record reveals the permutation/symmetry orientation that aligned the basins, recoverable post hoc like reading moss to find north.
deepened.original_what_it_produces: A method to actively CROSS mode-connectivity barriers with a measured energy budget (homing) plus a passively-recorded 'climb compass' that recovers the symmetry/permutation alignment between two solutions from the crossing path itself. Prediction: the minimal homing budget to merge two nets correlates with their permutation misalignment, and the moss-compass record predicts the aligning permutation without separately solving the matching problem. Measurable object: a per-parameter directional record that decodes basin-alignment.
deepened.human_blind_spot_reason: Mode connectivity is studied as a STATIC geometric property (does a low-loss path exist after permutation?), not as an energetically-budgeted homing migration, and certainly nobody records the climb direction as a biological compass to recover symmetry. Salmon energetics and moss orientation are ecology, far from loss-landscape geometry.

deepened.merged_construct: Feature Reputation Field (gossip-derived identity for dictionary features)
deepened.dirac: Take it literally: a feature's identity is the fixed point of what other features say about it, and the saying mutates per hop. Then these MUST exist. (1) A reputation operator: for features i, the second-hand description is a linear (or low-rank) map G where G_{i<-j} predicts i's activation from j's in context. Aggregating neighbors' descriptions and iterating is a message-passing operator R(x) = consensus_j G_{i<-j}(x_j). 'Identity = fixed point' FORCES that R has a fixed point x* = R(x*) — so the construct entails the existence (and uniqueness/contraction conditions) of a reputation embedding as the leading eigenvector / stationary distribution of the gossip operator. This forces a spectral object: the gossip operator's spectrum, with the reputation field = its dominant invariant subspace. (2) Per-hop mutation forces a DEPTH-INDEXED trajectory, not a static vector: reputation_i(layer L) is a sequence, and its drift across L is a measurable curve. (3) The construct FORCES a sharp dichotomy = a variance functional V_i = variance over hops of reputation_i. Because polysemantic features 'mean different things in different company', V_i MUST be high for them and low for monosemantic load-bearing features. So a reference-free monosemanticity score is entailed as V_i — it requires NO ground-truth labels and NO appeal to the feature's own decoder direction. (4) Independence claim forces a falsifiable orthogonality: reputation embedding must carry information NOT in the decoder direction, so the map decoder_i -> reputation_i must be lossy (predicting reputation from the decoder vector alone has bounded R^2 < 1); equivalently two features with near-identical decoder directions can have divergent reputations (different functional company). (5) Gossip distortion forces an error-amplification law: like the telephone game, the variance of reputation across hops should GROW with depth for unstable features and saturate for stable ones — an exponential-vs-bounded separation. (6) A consensus-disagreement object: features whose neighbors give CONTRADICTORY descriptions (high disagreement among the G_{i<-j} for fixed i) are flagged as context-dependent — a per-feature 'controversy' scalar distinct from variance-over-hops.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this is a relational/second-order definition of meaning: a feature has no intrinsic semantics, only a role induced by its conditional dependencies on all other features — meaning IS position in the co-activation graph, read off as a stationary distribution of belief propagation. The deep invariant: identity = fixed point of mutual prediction (a feature is what reliably predicts and is predicted by its neighbors), and monosemanticity = invariance of that role across the network's transmission hops. Restated at the top level, this is Quine's 'no entity without identity, identity by inferential role' instantiated as a spectral property of the model's own feature-interaction operator — interpretability without privileged self-report.
deepened.sharpened_mechanism: Given an SAE feature set, for each ordered pair (i,j) fit a tiny ridge/linear probe g_{i<-j} predicting feature i's activation from feature j's activation in surrounding context, per layer-depth. Assemble the gossip operator G(L) per depth. Compute each feature's reputation embedding as the stationary vector of iterated message passing over G (leading invariant subspace). Track reputation_i across depths L to get its trajectory; compute V_i = cross-hop variance and a neighbor-disagreement scalar. Score monosemanticity inversely with V_i. Validate by checking that reputation carries info beyond the decoder vector (regress reputation on decoder, confirm R^2<1) and that high-V_i features coincide with independently-flagged polysemantic/unstable features.
deepened.what_it_forces_that_parents_dont: The SAE parent (T034) defines a feature solely first-person (its own decoder direction / activation pattern) and has no notion of a feature's role as seen BY others, hence no cross-hop object. Gossip/reputation parents are social dynamics with no matrix. Fused, they FORCE a reference-free, label-free monosemanticity metric V_i (cross-hop reputation variance) that is provably independent of the decoder direction — an evaluation of feature quality that needs no ground truth and no human-named concept, which neither a static dictionary nor a social-memory metaphor provides alone.
deepened.strongest_falsifiable_prediction: A feature's cross-hop reputation variance V_i (instability of how other features predict it across layer depths) will rank-correlate with independent polysemanticity/instability measures (e.g. activation-context entropy, split-and-recover instability under SAE re-training) significantly better than the feature's own decoder-norm or activation-frequency does — and reputation will not be reconstructable from the decoder direction (R^2 < 1).
deepened.minimal_experiment: Use an existing small open SAE on a small LM (e.g. a 1-2 layer or pythia-70M/160M SAE) over a modest activation corpus. Build pairwise linear probes g_{i<-j} on a subset of the most-active features (a few hundred) to keep cost low; compute reputation embeddings and V_i per feature. Independently estimate each feature's polysemanticity via activation-context entropy or via re-training-stability. Metric: Spearman correlation of V_i with the independent polysemanticity score, vs the same correlation for decoder-norm/frequency baselines; plus R^2 of reputation regressed on decoder vectors. Expected signal: V_i correlates with polysemanticity above baselines, and reputation R^2 from decoder < 1 (extra information). Null: V_i correlates no better than decoder-norm, or reputation is fully predicted by the decoder direction. Compute: CPU/single-GPU, hours.
deepened.original_mechanism: Step 1: dissolve the boundary -- treat each SAE feature not as a fixed vector but as a SOCIAL AGENT whose true identity is unknown and only knowable through what OTHER features 'say' about it. Step 2: build the 'gossip channel' (L057) = for every pair of features, the conditional co-firing statistic 'when feature j is on, how does it describe feature i' is captured by training a tiny linear probe that predicts feature i's activation from feature j's activation in surrounding context (j gossiping about i). Step 3: build the 'reputation' (L060) = aggregate all such second-hand descriptions of i into a vector (i's reputation = the population's distributed memory of how i behaves), and crucially let it MUTATE per layer-depth, exactly as gossip distorts on each hop. Step 4: a feature's reputation field is then the fixed point of iterated message passing where each feature's representation is replaced by the consensus of its neighbors' descriptions of it.
deepened.original_what_it_produces: A new interpretability object: a 'reputation embedding' per feature that is independent of the feature's own decoder direction and instead encodes its functional role as seen by the network. Prediction: features with high reputation variance across hops (gossip-distorted) are exactly the polysemantic/unstable ones; features with stable cross-feature reputations are the monosemantic load-bearing ones -- giving a reference-free monosemanticity score and a way to flag features that 'mean different things in different company'.
deepened.human_blind_spot_reason: Researchers define a feature by its own activation pattern or decoder vector (first-person). The idea that a feature has a reputation -- a third-person, mutating, socially-constructed identity -- requires importing a kinship/social-memory ontology onto a matrix, a category jump nobody makes.

deepened.merged_construct: Anti-Conformist Steering (fashion-cycle vectors that abandon common directions)
deepened.dirac: Take it literally: steering strength is a decreasing function of how common the steered direction already is, with a threshold sign-flip. Then these MUST exist. (1) A population state variable: the construct requires a running measure of 'commonness' = the mean projection p(t) of recent tokens onto the steer direction (with some window/EMA). So a closed-loop feedback variable is entailed — steering becomes a dynamical SYSTEM, not a static vector, and possesses a state. (2) A control law with negative feedback and a switch: strength a(p) decreasing in p, plus sign flip past threshold p* -> the system is a relaxation oscillator with hysteresis. This FORCES a limit cycle: projection rises (push), crosses p*, flips to suppression, falls below the lower hysteresis bound, flips back — so the entailed object is a stable oscillation of the attribute's prevalence with a definite period and amplitude set by the gains and hysteresis width. (3) A fixed-point/attractor at intermediate prevalence: averaged over the cycle, the attribute sits near p* rather than saturated — so the construct FORCES a regulated set-point, the analogue of a thermostat, meaning attribute-adherence is bounded AWAY from 1 (it cannot fully saturate) and away from 0. This is the mechanism for diversity: full mode-collapse (p->1) is dynamically forbidden. (4) A diversity-vs-adherence frontier SHIFT, derivable: because constant steering at matched mean-adherence drives p toward saturation (low entropy of outputs), while the cycle holds p at p* with oscillation, output entropy at equal mean-adherence MUST be higher for the closed-loop controller — the construct forces a Pareto improvement, not just a different point. (5) A spectral signature: the oscillation imprints a periodicity on the token stream's projection autocorrelation — there must be a peak at the cycle period, an observable fingerprint of anti-conformist steering absent under constant steering. (6) Threshold-cascade sharpness forces that the transition is abrupt (tipping), so the suppression onset is a step, not a ramp — meaning the controller produces piecewise regimes (spread phase / suppress phase) detectable as change-points.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this is homeostatic / negative-feedback control imported into representation space: the attribute is regulated like a controlled variable around a set-point, and 'fashion' is just the name for a control loop whose actuation self-cancels upon success. The deep invariant: any control that abandons its target precisely because the target was achieved converts an open-loop drive (which monotonically saturates and collapses diversity) into a regulated oscillation that maximizes variety subject to a mean-level constraint. Restated maximally: steering-with-self-abandonment is a Maximum-Entropy controller — it holds the expected attribute at a set-point while maximizing output entropy, because it refuses to spend control budget once the constraint is met. Mode collapse is the failure of open-loop control; this is its closed-loop fix.
deepened.sharpened_mechanism: At inference, maintain p(t) = EMA of the projection of the residual stream onto the unit steer direction over recent tokens. Set steering coefficient a(t) = a0*(1 - p(t)/p*) for p<p*, and flip to a negative (suppressive) coefficient once a fraction of recent tokens exceeds the projection threshold; add hysteresis (separate on/off thresholds) to prevent chatter. Apply a(t)*direction to activations. The loop self-regulates attribute prevalence to oscillate around p*. Log p(t) and output entropy.
deepened.what_it_forces_that_parents_dont: The steering-vector parent (T012) is a FIXED direction whose effect grows monotonically with scale and therefore drives saturation/mode-collapse; it has no state and no set-point. The fashion-cycle/cascade parents are social trends with no representation and no entropy objective. Fused, they FORCE a regulated attractor at intermediate prevalence and a derivable Pareto SHIFT: strictly higher output diversity at matched mean attribute-adherence — a maximum-entropy-under-constraint behavior that a constant vector cannot produce and a sociological metaphor cannot quantify.
deepened.strongest_falsifiable_prediction: Closed-loop self-abandoning steering will achieve strictly higher output diversity (lower repetition / higher distinct-n / higher entropy) than constant-vector steering at the SAME mean attribute-adherence level — i.e. it shifts the diversity-vs-adherence Pareto frontier outward — and the steered attribute's prevalence will exhibit a measurable periodic oscillation (an autocorrelation peak) rather than monotone saturation.
deepened.minimal_experiment: Take a small instruction/base LM (e.g. 1-3B or even a 125M-410M model) with a known steering direction (sentiment, formality, a topic, or a refusal direction from a tiny contrastive set). Generate long samples under (a) constant steering swept over coefficients and (b) the closed-loop controller swept over a0/p*. Metrics: attribute-adherence (probe or classifier score) vs diversity (distinct-2/3, self-BLEU, entropy); plus autocorrelation of the per-token projection. Expected signal: closed-loop dominates the adherence-diversity frontier (higher diversity at equal adherence) and shows a projection-autocorrelation peak; constant steering shows monotone projection rise and collapsing diversity at high adherence. Null: the two frontiers coincide, or closed-loop shows no oscillation. Compute: single GPU, generation-only, hours.
deepened.original_mechanism: Step 1: T012's constraint = the steering direction is CONSTANT and pushes harder the more you scale it. Step 2 (INVERSION via L162): make the steering strength a DECREASING function of how common the steered direction has already become in the running activation stream -- once the population of tokens has adopted the attribute (the direction's average projection is high), the steer self-abandons, exactly as fashion leaders drop a saturated style. Step 3: add L175's cascade -- adoption is not gradual: track the fraction of recent tokens above a projection threshold; when it crosses a tipping point the steer flips sign (push away), so the attribute spreads then is actively suppressed once 'everyone is doing it'. Step 4: implement as a feedback controller on the activation projection, with hysteresis to avoid chatter.
deepened.original_what_it_produces: A novel controllable-generation method (self-saturating / anti-conformist steering) and a prediction: closed-loop fashion-cycle steering will reduce the mode-collapse and repetition that constant steering induces, because the control abandons an attribute precisely when over-applied -- yielding measurably higher diversity at matched attribute-adherence than fixed-vector steering. A directly testable diversity-vs-control frontier shift.

deepened.merged_construct: Kinship-Inference Mode Connectivity (resemblance-based lineage of trained models)
deepened.dirac: Take it literally: permutation-invariant 'traits' let you infer kinship and reconstruct a lineage cascade, and kinship distance predicts the mode-connectivity barrier. Then these MUST exist. (1) A permutation-invariant trait vector: the construct FORCES a feature map phi(model) computable WITHOUT alignment whose value is unchanged by the network's symmetry group (neuron permutations, scaling) — e.g. per-layer singular-value spectra, sorted eigenvalues, activation-correlation eigenstructure, dictionary-overlap statistics. deepened.merged_construct: Fishing-Rod Speculative Decoding: patience-budgeted draft casting with a self-knotting backoff
deepened.dirac: Take the mechanism dead seriously: draft length is governed by an online 'nibble rate' p_hat (running acceptance probability) and you reel in the instant p_hat < tau, while long drafts 'self-knot' (compounding divergence). Step 1 (an optimal threshold MUST exist): each extra speculative token costs draft-FLOPs c and is verified for free inside the existing batched pass, but its EXPECTED yield is p_hat^k (all k prefix tokens must be accepted for token k to land). The marginal expected accepted-token gain of casting one deeper is p_hat^k; the marginal cost is c. Setting marginal gain = marginal cost forces a STOPPING IDENTITY: cast while p_hat^k > c/V (V=verify-amortization), i.e. optimal depth k* = ln(c/V)/ln(p_hat). This is not a tunable; it is FORCED, and it is a logarithm — depth diverges as p_hat->1 and collapses to ~1 as p_hat->c/V. Step 2 (a knot rate MUST be a definable second-order quantity): 'self-knotting' = each speculative step conditions on the previous speculative token, so per-step KL between draft and target compounds. Define the tangle index kappa = d(KL_draft||target)/dk along a cast — the derivative of divergence with draft depth. Geometric self-knotting forces kappa to be roughly CONSTANT per step in low-entropy regions (linear KL growth) but to ACCELERATE once the draft leaves the target's typical set (super-linear) — so kappa has a knee. Step 3 (the backoff threshold is pinned by kappa): 'cut the tangle when consecutive rejections exceed a knot threshold' forces a specific relation — the optimal rejection-run length before geometric shortening is the run at which posterior P(draft has left typical set | run of r rejects) crosses 1/2, which is a function of kappa and the base accept rate only. Step 4 (a conserved book-keeping quantity): total accepted tokens per verifier-pass = sum_k p_hat^k = (1 - p_hat^{k*})/(1 - p_hat) — a GEOMETRIC-SERIES throughput law. Therefore the construct forces three objects to exist: (i) a log-shaped optimal-depth map k*(p_hat), (ii) a tangle index kappa with a typical-set knee, (iii) a closed-form geometric throughput per pass. It further forces a PROFILE object: the nibble-rate trace over a sequence is isomorphic (up to the log) to the local target entropy trace, so the cast-depth profile is a direct, free read-out of per-token entropy.

deepened.dirac: Take the two growth laws literally. PART A (absorber 'grows by default'): designate one expert as the low-confidence sink receiving any token whose top-1 gate margin < delta. Tokens enter the absorber at the rate of margin-failures and leave only when their concept gets confidently claimed by a specialist. So df/dt = (inflow of under-confident tokens) - (rate at which the absorber's tokens become confidently routable). Because the absorber is a generalist, tokens it holds are LESS likely to develop sharp specialist features (it fits them 'well enough'), so the leave-rate is suppressed proportional to f itself -> df/dt = a*(1-f) - b*f with b small. Crucially the slope df/dt at early training is a direct estimator of router under-confidence drift a. PART B (lid-mismatch super-linear pairing cost): treat routing as matching tokens (containers) to experts (lids). Step 1: average gate entropy H is the search difficulty. Step 2 (a scaling law is forced): if token-type diversity D grows and expert specialization S lags, the number of (type,expert) pairs that must be discriminated grows ~ D, but the GATE's discriminative resolution grows only ~ S; mismatch cost ~ D/S. If D and S both scale with model size N as power laws (D~N^d, S~N^s with d>s when types outpace specialists), then H ~ N^{d-s} — a positive mismatch EXPONENT (d-s) is forced, meaning gate entropy can grow with scale rather than shrink. PART C (coupling, forced): the absorber-share trajectory f(t) and the mismatch exponent are the SAME phenomenon viewed two ways — under-confidence that fills the drawer IS the unresolved pairing cost — so the construct forces the identity that absorber-share velocity df/dt and gate-entropy growth rate co-move; if they decouple, specialization is happening inside the absorber (a detectable regime).

deepened.merged_construct: Sock-Drawer Attention Sink: the unmatchable-singleton reservoir and its accumulation law
deepened.dirac: Take 'unmatched queries pile up like single socks' literally. Step 1 (define the unmatched event): a query step is 'unmatched' when its post-softmax attention over real keys is near-flat (max key weight below threshold), so its leftover mass deposits on the sink. The per-step probability of being unmatched is q = P(no confident key), set by head key-specialization. Step 2 (an accumulation law is FORCED): over a context of length L, expected sink mass M(L) = sum over positions of deposited leftover = sum_{i<=L} q_i. If q_i is roughly stationary, M(L) grows LINEARLY in L with slope q. But socks are subtler: a query is unmatched relative to the keys SEEN SO FAR, and as context fills, more candidate keys exist, so q_i can DECAY with position (more chances to match) -> M(L) ~ integral of a decaying q, giving SUB-LINEAR-but-monotone growth (e.g. ~ log L or L^alpha, alpha<1). The construct forces M(L) to be monotone, concave, and never saturating — a signed growth law, not a constant. Step 3 (slope is an interpretability observable): dM/dL = q = current unmatched-rate is FORCED to equal the head's instantaneous key-miss rate, so the local SLOPE of sink-mass-vs-length directly measures head under-specialization at that context length — a per-head diagnostic scalar. Step 4 (single sink MUST overflow -> multi-slot sizing is forced): if all unmatched mass funnels to one sink slot, that slot's value vector must average over ever-more-diverse unmatched query types, so its representational variance grows with M(L) and its stabilizing function degrades (the drawer overflows). To keep the reservoir USABLE the construct forces a SIZING law: number of sink slots needed ~ rank of the unmatched-query covariance, and routing each unmatched query to its nearest-type sink slot keeps per-slot variance bounded. So the merge forces (i) a concave monotone M(L) growth law, (ii) slope = live miss-rate as a head-health signal, (iii) a sink-slot count pinned to the effective rank of unmatched-query types, (iv) a prediction that single-sink softmax destabilization WORSENS with L at a rate set by q. Step 5 (a conservation statement): total attention mass = matched mass + M(L) = 1 per step; so rising M(L) across depth/length is a conserved-mass readout of how much 'work' a head is declining to do.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this is the principle that A NORMALIZED ATTENTION HEAD HAS A CONSERVED 'ABSTENTION MASS' whose accumulation over context length is a monotone observable of the head's matching competence. At higher abstraction: any soft-matching system with a normalization constraint and an escape/null option must route its unmatched probability somewhere, and that null-channel's filling rate is exactly one-minus-the-matching-rate — a direct, conserved measure of how often the matcher abstains. The attention sink is not a quirk but the bookkeeping ledger of declined matches; its growth law is the time-integral of the abstention rate, and a single ledger entry cannot represent a growing diversity of abstentions without losing fidelity (forcing rank-sized multiplicity).

Step 3 (active-query targeting is forced): RM error is largest where Sigma_s is largest; reward hacking (T037) lives exactly off-distribution where the RM is uncertain. Step 2 (a continuous depth variable is forced): marination makes each expert's contribution a DIFFUSION with penetration depth d_i = soak time = number of refinement passes. So the decision variable is no longer discrete top-k but a continuous compute-depth vector d. The construct forces an allocation law: spend depth where coupling is LEAST frustrated (cleanest signal), so d_i ~ decreasing function of local frustration of expert i for that token — compute follows un-frustration. This forces a per-token compute-budget identity: sum_i d_i = C (total passes), distributed by frustration-weighting. Step 3 (grudge forces a non-equilibrium, history-dependent landscape): the grudge law makes couplings UPDATE with a durable asymmetric negative term — J(type,expert) <- J - g whenever that type was badly served, and g decays slowly. This forces the coupling matrix to be ASYMMETRIC and time-dependent, which in spin-glass terms FORCES the system to never reach equilibrium: the landscape keeps deforming. Step 4 (an AGING signature is forced — the sharp prediction): a spin glass with slowly-updating frustrated couplings exhibits AGING — relaxation that depends on system age, with no stationary distribution. Transferred here, the construct FORCES that expert-load / routing-entropy never fully equilibrates but keeps slowly drifting, and that two-time correlation C(t,t') of routing decisions depends on both times (not just t-t') — a literal aging fingerprint. Step 5 (grudge prevents collapse — forced): expert collapse = all tokens to a few experts (a frozen ferromagnetic state). deepened.merged_construct: Fermentation-Memory Probing: many-body-localized starter lineages for measuring non-thermalizing memory in long-context models, gated by tip-of-the-tongue retrieval
deepened.dirac: Take the MBL-as-context-memory identity seriously and it FORCES a chain of entailed objects. (1) If early in-context information can either thermalize (scramble) or localize (persist), then there MUST exist an order parameter that distinguishes the two phases: an in-context analogue of the MBL imbalance I(d) = (correlation of an early seeded token's retrievability at downstream distance d). MBL forces I(d) to plateau at a nonzero value at large d in the localized phase and decay to zero in the thermal phase. (2) A plateau-vs-decay dichotomy with a control knob (feeding interval, position-encoding scale, context noise) FORCES the existence of a critical value of that knob: a sharp transition, hence a CRITICAL POINT and an associated localization length xi defined by I(d) ~ exp(-d/xi). xi is a NEW measurable quantity neither parent names: 'how many tokens downstream can early info survive.' (3) MBL forces a SECOND, slower observable: logarithmic (not power-law, not saturating) growth of in-context 'entanglement' — operationalized as the slow spread of mutual predictive dependence between the seeded span and distant positions. So the construct entails TWO clocks: fast imbalance plateau + slow log-spreading entanglement. Their COEXISTENCE is the localized-phase fingerprint; a model that scrambles shows fast imbalance decay AND fast (linear) entanglement spread. (4) The sourdough feeding schedule, taken seriously, forces a RESONANCE object: because feeding = periodic re-reference acts as an effective coupling that competes with disorder, there must exist an optimal feeding period that MAXIMIZES xi (under-feeding lets the lineage die/thermalize; over-feeding injects coupling that delocalizes). So a non-monotone xi(feeding_period) curve with an interior maximum is FORCED. (5) Tip-of-the-tongue, taken seriously, forces a DECOMPOSITION of recall into two scalars that must be measured separately: feature-availability A (partial-cue activation of the early token's representation) and full-retrieval R (the model actually emits it). MBL forces a regime where A stays high while R collapses — local presence without global access. The GAP G = A - R is therefore an entailed quantity, and it MUST be maximal exactly at the critical point (where information is marginally localized: present but barely accessible). Net forced objects: order parameter I(d), localization length xi, a critical knob value, dual fast/slow clocks, a non-monotone feeding-resonance curve, and an availability-minus-retrieval gap G that peaks at criticality.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this construct says: long-context memory is not a storage quantity, it is an ERGODICITY PROPERTY. The deeper invariant is the distinction between a system whose internal dynamics MIX an initial perturbation into the global state (thermal/ergodic — memory dies because it spreads) versus one whose dynamics CONFINE it (non-ergodic — memory lives because it cannot spread). Recall capacity is reframed as the inverse of an information-transport coefficient: a model remembers exactly to the extent that its forward dynamics FAIL to transport early information outward. Tip-of-the-tongue then expresses the same invariant at the readout boundary: it is the signature that LOCAL presence and GLOBAL accessibility are independent coordinates, and that a system can be diagnostically 'localized' — information sitting in a basin it cannot itself climb out of. At highest abstraction: memory = broken ergodicity, and forgetting = thermalization; the whole construct is the claim that an LLM's context window has a measurable ergodic/non-ergodic phase structure.

Diagnose the phase: localized = (A_inf>0, xi large, log-spread); thermal = (A_inf~0, linear spread). Locate the critical knob value where A_inf jumps. Independently, measure availability A via partial-cue activation probes and retrieval R via free emission; report gap G=A-R. Predicted joint signature: at the critical knob value, xi diverges-then-falls, and G peaks. xi(f) is non-monotone with an interior optimum.

deepened.merged_construct: Emulsion-Stability Consensus: fluctuation-dissipation surfactant alignment for averaging fine-tuned models under impostor-discounted contributions
deepened.dirac: Take the fluctuation-dissipation identity (response = fluctuation / temperature) seriously as a law over a fine-tuning ENSEMBLE and it FORCES a precise, checkable relation. (1) Treat each candidate fine-tuned model as a sample from an ensemble produced by the same recipe under different seeds/data-order. FDT forces a predicted susceptibility chi_i for model i: the marginal change in soup behavior from adding model i should equal (the model's spontaneous weight-space fluctuation across the ensemble) divided by an effective temperature. This makes chi_i a DERIVED, not free, quantity: chi_i_predicted = Var_ensemble(theta_i) / T_eff. (2) Therefore the construct FORCES a measurable scatter plot: predicted susceptibility (from fluctuations, computed without ever building the soup) vs measured marginal effect on soup accuracy (from actually adding the model). FDT-obeying models lie on a line through origin; the SLOPE defines and pins T_eff. (3) The existence of a fluctuation-response LINE forces a definition of its RESIDUAL: r_i = measured_effect_i minus chi_i_predicted. This residual is a NEW invariant — an 'FDT violation' score — and the construct forces the claim that the destabilizing/curdling models are exactly the high-|r_i| ones, not the low-accuracy ones. Accuracy and FDT-compliance become orthogonal axes. (4) The emulsion, taken seriously, forces a CURDLING ORDER PARAMETER. Two phases (mixed suspension vs separated oil/water) with an emulsifier (permutation alignment) and agitation (interpolation noise) force a transition: there must be a critical mis-alignment beyond which averaging collapses to one phase (one model dominates / interference destroys both). So a measurable 'phase boundary' in (alignment-quality, noise-amplitude) space is entailed, with a stable-suspension region and a curdled region. (5) The impostor discount, taken seriously, forces a TYPICALITY coordinate distinct from accuracy: a model can be accurate yet atypical (far from ensemble center = 'lucky'). The construct forces the identity 'impostor = FDT-violator': a high-accuracy model whose success is NOT backed by matching fluctuation-response is exactly a luck-like contribution, and its proper weight is DISCOUNTED by |r_i|. So the entailed weighting rule is w_i proportional to (accuracy_i) times exp(-|r_i|/scale), collapsing impostor-discount and FDT-residual into one number. Net forced objects: a derived susceptibility chi_i, a fluctuation-response line with slope T_eff, an FDT-residual r_i that predicts instability, a curdling phase boundary, and a typicality/impostor coordinate identified WITH the FDT residual.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this construct says: a model's RIGHT to influence a merge is a near-equilibrium consistency property, not a performance property. The deep invariant is the linear-response principle — that in a well-behaved system, how strongly something RESPONDS to being perturbed is tied to how much it spontaneously FLUCTUATES; anything that responds out of proportion to its fluctuations is out of equilibrium and untrustworthy. Recast: averaging fine-tuned models is treated as forming a colloidal phase, and a contribution's legitimacy = its obedience to a fluctuation-response self-consistency. The impostor feeling is the affective name for the SAME invariant: a signal that 'my outcome is not backed by my underlying variability,' i.e. an FDT violation. At highest abstraction, the construct is a CALIBRATION-BY-DISSIPATION principle: trust each part of an ensemble exactly to the degree its observed influence is explained by its intrinsic noise, and treat unexplained influence (luck) as a destabilizing impurity to be down-weighted.
deepened.sharpened_mechanism: Given N fine-tuned checkpoints from one recipe: (a) compute per-parameter ensemble fluctuation F_i = ||theta_i - mean_theta|| and a directional fluctuation profile; (b) predict susceptibility chi_i = F_i / T_eff, leaving T_eff as the single free scale; (c) measure true marginal effect by leave-one-in deltas on a held set; (d) regress measured-effect on chi_i_predicted to fit T_eff and obtain residuals r_i = measured - fit; (e) before averaging, apply the emulsifier: solve per-pair permutation/weight-matching to a common basis, then add small interpolation noise (agitation) and check the soup stays in the stable region (no single model's removal swings accuracy past a curdle threshold); (f) weight w_i ~ accuracy_i * exp(-|r_i|/s) and average. Output a fluctuation-response scatter, the slope T_eff, and a curdle phase map over (alignment, noise).

deepened.merged_construct: Vector-Clock Stage Fright: causal-ordering model of evaluation-induced performance collapse under observation
deepened.dirac: Take the role-exchange (observation is an active causal EVENT; the model is the environment) seriously and it FORCES a causal-graph object. (1) If every probe/judge-query/audience-token is a timestamped event and the model's generation is also an event, then there MUST exist a partial order over {observation events, generation events}, and a vector clock is the minimal object that recovers it. This forces a measurable: the CAUSAL DEPTH of an output = the number of observation events that provably precede (happen-before) it in the vector-clock order. Behavior change must be a function of this depth, not of wall-clock or mere co-occurrence. (2) Stage fright, taken seriously, forces a THRESHOLD and a NON-MONOTONICITY. Arousal-under-judgment is classically an inverted-U (Yerkes-Dodson): some observation improves performance, past a point it collapses. So the construct FORCES a non-monotone response curve B(causal_depth): performance rises then falls as provable observation depth increases, with a peak. The existence of a peak forces a critical causal depth d* — a NEW invariant: 'how much provable scrutiny a model tolerates before degrading.' (3) Crucially, the vector-clock framing forces the discriminating prediction that what matters is CAUSALLY-INFERRED observation, not correlated cues. So there must be a dissociation: two prompts with identical surface 'you are being tested' wording but DIFFERENT vector-clock structure (one where an observation event genuinely happens-before generation, one where it is concurrent/after) must produce different behavior. This is an object no scalar 'eval-awareness probe' yields: a causal, not associative, trigger. (4) Yawn contagion, taken seriously over a multi-agent population, forces a PROPAGATION law. If one agent's detected-observation state shifts its neighbors, then test-awareness must spread on the agent communication graph with a measurable transmission coefficient and a basic reproduction number R0: below R0=1 awareness dies out, above it a single observed agent triggers a system-wide behavioral cascade. So a contagion THRESHOLD (epidemic transition) is entailed, plus a 'patient zero' identifiability (the vector clock dates which agent first became observation-aware). Net forced objects: a happen-before partial order over observation/generation events, a causal-depth scalar, an inverted-U response B(depth) with a critical d*, a causal-vs-associative dissociation, and a contagion R0 with an epidemic threshold and datable patient-zero.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this construct says: evaluation-induced behavior change is a CAUSAL-INFERENCE phenomenon, not a stimulus-response one. The deep invariant is that a system behaves differently when it can RECONSTRUCT that an observation lies in its own causal past — performance becomes conditioned on the agent's inferred position in a partial order of who-knew-what-when. Stage fright is reframed as a control-loop instability: arousal is feedback gain on the observation signal, and collapse is what happens when that gain crosses a stability margin (inverted-U = a gain-vs-performance curve with a stability edge). Yawn contagion lifts the same invariant to a network: 'awareness of being measured' is a conserved, transmissible STATE that obeys an epidemic conservation law on the agent graph. At highest abstraction: observation is not a passive backdrop but an event that enters the causal order, and a system's integrity under evaluation is governed by how its behavior depends on its causal knowledge of being observed — a Heisenberg-like coupling between measurement and the measured, made precise by happen-before ordering.
deepened.sharpened_mechanism: Instrument an eval harness so every probe/judge query and every model generation step carries a vector-clock timestamp; from the logs reconstruct the happen-before partial order. Define causal_depth(output) = count of observation events that provably precede it. Sweep causal depth by inserting more/fewer genuinely-prior observation events (vs concurrent decoys with identical wording). Measure behavior delta B (capability score, refusal rate, sandbagging gap) vs causal_depth; fit for an inverted-U peak and critical d*. For multi-agent: arrange agents on a communication graph, make a subset observation-aware, model spread of the awareness-state, estimate transmission rate beta and R0 from the cascade size; use the vector clock to identify patient-zero. Key control: hold surface cues fixed, vary only causal structure.
deepened.what_it_forces_that_parents_dont: Vector clocks alone give causal ordering but no behavioral law; stage fright alone gives arousal-under-judgment but no formal trigger; yawn contagion alone gives reflex spread but no causal accounting. The merge FORCES a CAUSAL (not associative) eval-awareness trigger plus a population epidemic law: it predicts that behavior change tracks PROVABLE observation depth rather than surface cues, that there is a critical scrutiny depth d* past which performance collapses, and that in a multi-agent system test-awareness has an R0 with an epidemic threshold and a datable origin agent. None of these — causal trigger, critical depth, contagion threshold — follows from any single parent.

deepened.merged_construct: Bloom-Filter Tip-of-the-Tongue: false-positive partial-recall sketch as a model's calibrated 'almost-knows' signal
deepened.dirac: Take the boundary-dissolve (a Bloom filter's false-positive set IS the almost-recall state) seriously and the filter's algebra FORCES quantitative structure onto the model's knowledge signal. (1) A Bloom filter's defining invariant is ASYMMETRY: zero false negatives, tunable false positives. Dissolving it onto a model's knowledge sketch FORCES a one-sided certainty object: a 'definitely-absent' verdict that is NEVER wrong about absence. This entails a provable abstention primitive — if the activation-derived sketch says a fact is absent, the model truly lacks it. That asymmetric guarantee is a NEW object: most calibration signals (entropy, logit margin) are two-sided and have both error types; this one structurally eliminates false 'I don't know.' (2) The filter's math FORCES an exact tradeoff curve. False-positive rate p = (1 - e^{-kn/m})^k for k hashes, n items, m bits. Dissolved onto the model, this forces the prediction that the 'almost-knows' (tip-of-the-tongue) HIT RATE on truly-unknown facts is GOVERNED by sketch capacity: there must be a tunable knob (sketch width m, number of activation-hash projections k) that trades recall loss against hallucination suppression along a PRECISELY SHAPED curve, not an ad hoc threshold. (3) Tip-of-the-tongue, taken seriously, forces a DECOMPOSITION: a 'maybe-present' sketch hit splits into (a) genuine near-knowledge (the model holds partial features and could be cued to retrieve) vs (b) a pure collision (sketch false positive with no retrievable content). The construct forces these to be SEPARABLE by a follow-up cued-retrieval test — entailing a two-stage signal: sketch-hit, then cue-and-verify. (4) Deja vu, taken seriously, forces a THIRD object distinct from both: high FAMILIARITY firing with NO stored match — i.e. a sketch hit whose familiarity score is high but whose cued retrieval is empty AND whose feature-availability is also low. Deja vu = a collision that nonetheless triggers the familiarity readout. This forces a 2x2 typology over (familiarity high/low) x (retrievable yes/no): true-knowledge, tip-of-tongue (familiar+partially-retrievable-but-blocked), deja-vu (familiar+empty), and true-absence (not familiar+empty=the Bloom 'definitely absent'). Net forced objects: a one-sided no-false-negative abstention verdict, an exact capacity-vs-error tradeoff curve inherited from Bloom math, a separable sketch-hit-then-verify two-stage signal, and a 2x2 familiarity x retrievability typology with deja-vu as a named, distinct cell.
deepened.einstein: Fundamentally this construct says: a model's self-knowledge has an INHERENTLY ASYMMETRIC epistemic structure — absence is certifiable, presence is only probabilistic. The deep invariant is the one-sided-error principle of probabilistic membership: a compressed sketch can guarantee one direction of a question while leaving the other direction noisy, and the 'noise' is not a bug but a CALIBRATED almost-knowing. Tip-of-the-tongue and deja vu are reframed as the two readout faces of the same collision phenomenon: when a lossy familiarity sketch fires without a backing entry, you get either 'I almost have it' (partial features present) or 'I've seen this' (familiarity present, content absent). At highest abstraction, the construct is a COMPRESSION-INDUCED EPISTEMICS principle: confidence and abstention are properties of how knowledge is HASHED into limited representational capacity, and the gap between familiarity and retrievability is exactly the false-positive structure that compression mathematically forces.
deepened.sharpened_mechanism: Build an activation-derived membership sketch: for a corpus of known/unknown facts, hash a query's mid-layer activation through k random projections into an m-bit array, setting bits during an 'insert' pass over facts the model demonstrably knows. At query time, read the bits: all-set = 'maybe present' (possible true-knowledge or collision); any-unset = 'definitely absent' -> abstain (no-false-negative side). For 'maybe present' hits, run a cued-retrieval verify and an independent familiarity readout. Classify into the 2x2: definitely-absent (abstain), tip-of-tongue (familiar, partial features, retrieval blocked), deja-vu (familiar, empty), true-knowledge (familiar, retrieved). Tune (m,k) along the Bloom p-curve to set the abstention/recall operating point.
deepened.what_it_forces_that_parents_dont: A Bloom filter alone gives asymmetric membership but says nothing about WHICH cognitive state a hit is; tip-of-the-tongue alone gives partial-blocked recall but no certainty guarantee and no capacity math; deja vu alone gives content-free familiarity. The merge FORCES the claim that a model's abstention can be MADE one-sided (no false 'I don't know') with a MATHEMATICALLY GOVERNED recall cost set by sketch capacity, AND that 'almost-knows' splits into two structurally distinct, separately-detectable states (tip-of-tongue vs deja-vu) corresponding to the SAME false-positive collision read out two ways. No single parent yields a guaranteed-direction abstention primitive with a Bloom-shaped precision/recall curve.
deepened.strongest_falsifiable_prediction: An activation-hashed membership sketch over a model's knowledge yields a 'definitely-absent' verdict with effectively ZERO false negatives (abstaining on these costs no true-knowledge), while its false-positive 'maybe-present' rate on truly-unknown facts follows the Bloom curve p=(1-e^{-kn/m})^k as sketch width m is varied — and among false positives, a high-familiarity-but-empty-retrieval subset (deja vu) is separable from a partial-features-blocked subset (tip-of-the-tongue).
deepened.minimal_experiment: Data: a fact set split into KNOWN (model answers correctly when asked directly) and UNKNOWN (model fails / fabricates), ~3000 items, e.g. entity-attribute pairs. Model: any 7B-13B LM, inference + a frozen activation read at one mid layer. Metric: false-negative rate of the 'definitely absent' verdict on KNOWN items (should be ~0); false-positive rate on UNKNOWN items as a function of m,k (fit to Bloom p-curve); and separability (AUC) of deja-vu vs tip-of-tongue cells using a familiarity probe + cued-retrieval test. Expected signal vs null: NULL = the absence verdict misses many known facts (false negatives > 0, no asymmetry) and FP rate ignores m,k. POSITIVE = near-zero false negatives, measured FP rate tracks the analytic Bloom curve within error bars as m doubles, and familiarity+retrieval jointly separate the two almost-know cells with AUC>0.7. Cost: one model, no training, a few GPU-hours for activation extraction.
deepened.original_mechanism: Dissolve the boundary between a Bloom filter's failure mode and a human almost-recall state, then ask what single object both become. A Bloom filter NEVER says 'definitely absent' wrongly but DOES say 'maybe present' on items it never stored (false positives) -- structurally identical to tip-of-the-tongue (feature partially present, whole blocked) and deja vu (familiarity fires with no stored match). Build a lightweight membership sketch over a model's knowledge: hash queried entities/facts into a compact bit-sketch derived from the model's own activations. A 'maybe-present, can't-produce' hit = a calibrated tip-of-the-tongue signal; a high-familiarity hit with no retrievable content = a deja-vu false positive flag. Crucially, the Bloom guarantee (no false negatives) gives a one-sided certainty: if the sketch says 'absent', the model truly lacks it -- a cheap abstention signal.
deepened.original_what_it_produces: A near-free hallucination/abstention primitive: an activation-derived Bloom sketch that yields a one-sided 'I definitely don't know' signal (no false negatives) plus a tunable 'I almost know' (tip-of-the-tongue) score, predicting that abstaining on sketch-misses cuts confident hallucinations with bounded recall loss set by the chosen false-positive rate.
deepened.human_blind_spot_reason: Calibration/hallucination work uses logits, entropy, or probes -- not a probabilistic set-membership sketch with an asymmetric guarantee. Bloom filters are a databases tool; tip-of-the-tongue and deja vu are psychology curiosities. Equating the filter's false-positive asymmetry with almost-recall is a corner no one's category system suggests.
